key_decisions.decision: Bind the complete historical title and opening confession together; retain Saul separately named.
Keep the difficult brightness-to-cloud transition and its hail/fire accompaniment.
Retain the repeated hail and coals in the pinned text rather than assimilating the parallel song.
Retain the speaker’s consequential claim of righteous conduct and bodily metaphor.
Preserve the unsettling last contrast; shrewd conveys the reflexive twisting response.
Keep divine gentleness or condescension as the striking source of greatness; note the lexical question.
Retain the speaker’s relentless violence without recasting enemies as abstract faults.
Keep the explicit physical defeat and inability to stand.
Repeat girding and preserve the rising/falling opposition.
Render giving the neck as flight while retaining lethal intent.
Do not omit the enemies’ appeal to the same LORD or its refusal.
Preserve both degrading images and the pinned pour-out verb.
Follow the read form magnifying victories and retain the explicit Davidic conclusion.
